tasks.goal: Guide visitors along the Charter Hall exhibit path, gesturing at each charter display panel while narrating the DAO's contribution model.
tasks.terrain: Polished exhibit hall flooring near 1111 Lincoln Road; avoid stanchions, display plinths and visitor queues.
success: Visits all 5 display waypoints in order
Localization error < 0.15 m at each waypoint
Speech completes at each stop before moving on
safety_stops: E-stop on obstacle within 0.3 m on planned path
Stop speech and motion on battery < 20%
tasks.human_in_loop: A human docent approves the tour script content before each public run.

tasks.goal: Autonomously scan research binders and monitor shelves with the torso camera, logging which bays have been inspected.
tasks.terrain: Narrow aisle between shelf racks; cable runs on floor from lab workstations to be crossed safely.
success: Camera captures each shelf face with >90% frame coverage
Scan log written for every bay
safety_stops: Stop if torso camera occluded >5 s
Stop on wheel slip detected on cables
tasks.human_in_loop: A human researcher verifies the scan log completeness before archival.

tasks.goal: Set up the proposal review table by placing nameplates, tablets and ballot boxes at marked positions from a supply tray.
tasks.terrain: Fixed table mounted on the forum deck; must not collide with glass railing edges of the open-air structure.
success: 6 of 6 items placed within 2 cm of targets
safety_stops: Stop if hand detected in workspace
Pause on vision loss of target >3 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A human steward confirms the seating layout matches the session roster before use.

tasks.goal: Carry printed task-routing packets from the Operations Deck printer stand to the working-group desks on the same level.
tasks.terrain: Concrete parking-deck floor with painted stall lines, drainage slots and occasional vehicle drip spots; ramps avoided.
success: Mean position error < 0.25 m per drop
safety_stops: E-stop on human within 1 m at walking speed
tasks.human_in_loop: A human coordinator approves the delivery manifest before the robot departs.

tasks.goal: Patrol the garage's open-air levels to verify workstation equipment is powered down and no hazards remain after DAO working hours.
tasks.terrain: Open-air concrete slabs of the 1111 Lincoln Road garage: painted stall lines, low walls, floor drain covers, coastal humidity-slick patches.
success: Covers patrol route on 2 assigned levels
Emits hazard report with photos for each station
No trips on drain covers or low walls
safety_stops: Stop on unexpected gap or edge detected
tasks.human_in_loop: A human operations lead reviews the hazard report and authorizes any follow-up tasks.

tasks.goal: Precision-mount progress-dashboard display brackets onto the observatory wall grid at calibrated hole positions.
tasks.terrain: Wall grid beside the observatory window overlooking Lincoln Road; cable trays along baseboard constrain base placement.
success: 4 brackets seated within 1 mm target tolerance
safety_stops: Stop on human within 1.5 m of workspace
Stop on vision marker loss >2 s
tasks.human_in_loop: A human supervisor approves final bracket positions against the wall plan before mounting begins.

tasks.goal: Fly a low-altitude visual sweep of the observatory deck to capture progress-board images for the tracking dashboard.
tasks.terrain: Open-air breezeway subject to coastal wind gusts off the Atlantic; ceiling beams and hanging signage act as aerial obstacles.
success: Captures all 5 progress boards in focus
safety_stops: Hover-stop on person entering sweep volume
tasks.human_in_loop: A human tracker approves the flight plan and reviews captured images for dashboard use.

tasks.goal: Haul AV cases and staging crates from the garage service elevator landing to the Proposal Forum stage position for a decision-cycle session.
tasks.terrain: Rough transition from service corridor to open deck with a 5 deg ramp, expansion joints and evening-condensation slick concrete.
success: All 3 crates delivered to stage mark within 0.2 m
No crate shift during ramp transit
Zero collisions with walls or signage
safety_stops: Stop on wheel slip > 0.3 on ramp
tasks.human_in_loop: A human event steward confirms stage placement and unloads the crates before session start.
